text: Good evening ma, sorry to disturb you this night. I am the aunty of a baby boy of 7 months, I am keeping him for my sister. Since yesterday he is having temperature and when I checked now it is 39.1. His one eye is pink and sticky, the thing is gumming the eyelashes together, and he has small cough, not much, just here and there. I don't know if I should wait for morning or carry him somewhere tonight. I am sorry for troubling you, I just want to do the correct thing for him. Thank you ma.
